rules.source: Loi n° 001-2021/AN du 30 mars 2021 portant protection des personnes à l'égard du traitement des données à caractère personnel — https://assembleenationale.bf/storage/Loi/kDsWHXOTUCQFVESChh8BlBdiZnCrdTsOpXe1rzmH.pdf
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary of the National Assembly PDF: article 1 states the law aims to protect the fundamental rights and freedoms of natural persons regarding processing of their personal data; covers automated and non-automated processing; applies to controllers established in Burkina Faso and foreign controllers operating from its territory (art. 3). Press reports fines of 5 to 100 million FCFA; CIL is the independent authority.
